The race to build better AI depends on knowing whose expertise you can trust. When fabricated résumés enter the expert pipeline, the risk reaches beyond a bad hire. It reaches the judgment used to train and evaluate models.

The person who passes the interview isn’t always the person who does the work. On expert marketplaces, approved accounts are leased or sold. The credentials are real. The person using them isn’t. A check at the door verifies the profile, not who’s behind it next week.
